execution_boundary.local_actions: Read selected source files, annotation examples and primary papers; hashed exact bytes and Git objects.

local_contract.observable_input: Frozen declared method/variant source packet and registered dependencies; source evidence rather than current extractor output.
local_contract.target: Independently adjudicated source-supported claims and necessary input/output, lineage, branch, condition, information and order constraints, allowing explicit scientifically adequate representation alternatives.
local_contract.topology_boundary: Exact reference node/edge topology is a secondary diagnostic: task ontologies, composite/split granularity, serialization roots, helper nodes and connector assumptions differ across inspected implementations.
local_contract.denominator_rule: Required reference obligations and complete candidate claims determine eligible counts before lexical/semantic alignment; unmatched items remain visible.
local_contract.count_boundary: Twelve methods and more than five types are the requested scope, not optimal or statistically validated sample sizes.

repositories.checkout_scope: Shallow filtered clone with sparse selected files; no submodules or model artifacts fetched.

findings: PEGNode preserves display name, AMR-safe name and text-span coordinates; process events retain inputs, outputs and simulator step.
PEG.to_amr reverses the graph for a last-event root and introduces additional name nodes and op1 mention triples; the serialized topology is a projection of its PEG object.
edge_to_amr emits successor relations for event-event links and core-role argument routing.
call-graph-format.md explicitly documents dummy temporal edges between adjacent disconnected components to obtain a connected AMR, assuming textual execution order.
One paired protocol example was inspected to trace source mention names, serializations and conditions; this is not a corpus-quality estimate.
adopt: Source/mention anchoring and explicit operation argument interfaces.
reject: Dummy connectors as source-supported flow or order.
Last-event root and AMR name-node expansion as universal scientific topology.
Executability-driven deletion of source-supported composite operations.

repositories.checkout_scope: Shallow filtered clone with sparse selected files; no submodules or model artifacts fetched.
repositories.inspection_extent: Selected executable paths and annotation/schema examples; not a complete source audit.
findings: Entity evaluation outer-joins start/end/step coordinates and compares labels. Relation evaluation outer-joins ordered endpoint span pairs and compares relation labels, filling unmatched entries with the negative class.

The inspected relation matching key does not itself conjoin endpoint entity-label correctness; entity typing is separately scored and can affect relation-group assignment. Do not assume every reported relation number implements the paper strictness sentence identically.
MetaEvalWLP defaults max_gap=5 and filters CAPTAC/inter-CAPTAC summaries to ranges below that value, while FULL evaluation does not impose the same gap filter.
Preprocessing constructs lowercased, digit-replaced model inputs and treats Or, Overlaps and Coreference-Link as undirected classes.
BRAT parsing resolves event IDs to trigger text spans and flattens event arguments into binary links; numeric suffixes are removed from role names.
The repository gitlink pins wlp-mstg-dataset at 08c20d56304bbcd79ccf34bc91170f6df5bc438e, which differs from the independently inspected dataset HEAD.
adopt: Retaining unmatched prediction/reference rows in metric denominators.
adapt: Separate full, within-action, cross-action, implicitness and distance views with declared eligibility.
reject: Silent distance filtering for source completeness.
Lowercasing/digit replacement/undirected model classes as edits to reference scientific evidence.

repositories.checkout_scope: Shallow filtered clone with sparse selected files; no submodules or model artifacts fetched.
repositories.inspection_extent: Selected executable paths and annotation/schema examples; not a complete source audit.
findings: Official evaluation entrypoint serializes graph objects into actor-grouped textual flow triples and updates LexicalBased statistics from generated text.

single_span_match selects a best lexical span and rejects it below span_threshold=0.5; spans_exact_match adds prediction/reference totals only inside if matched branches. Fully unmatched lines may be omitted from the denominators on this path.
lexical_score is lemma membership-overlap F1, while compute_bleu separately uses unigram NLTK BLEU after token filtering. Several local variable names do not distinguish the two.
same_parsed_match_threshold=0.8 supports parsed-node reuse; node_match_threshold=1 is a different setting. Start/end and OR node matching include type-specific shortcuts.
These are static code observations at the pinned revision. No scorer execution or published numerical result was reproduced.
adopt: Explicit actors, branches and conditions as inspection aspects when the source supports them.
adapt: Separate node/constraint, gateway and flow diagnostics.
reject: Lexical gating that removes unmatched items from completeness/support denominators.
Fuzzy parsed-node collapse as scientific identity.
Graph-first constructed document topology as source-first assay gold.

findings: Heuristic one-to-one variable alignment uses smart initialization followed by random restarts and greedy move/swap improvements.
Initialization calls random.seed() internally; externally seeding alone does not pin this code path.
normalize lowercases and strips trailing underscores. Parsing adds a TOP attribute; tests intentionally penalize changing only the root.
Corpus mode sums matching/predicted/reference triple counts before computing its aggregate. Unequal graph counts emit a warning and ignore the remaining graphs.

Triple lists and nested cross-comparisons motivate an explicit duplicate policy. Historical issue15 reports an above-one result, but this audit did not execute the example or claim universal current failure.
adopt: Local-variable renaming invariance for a declared structural diagnostic.
adapt: Exact triple comparison only after a source-appropriate normalization contract.
reject: One-to-one node alignment as the sole measure for admissible composite/split assay descriptions.
AMR root/case rules or silent document truncation as benchmark defaults.

repositories.checkout_scope: Shallow filtered clone with sparse selected files; no submodules or model artifacts fetched.
repositories.inspection_extent: Selected executable paths and annotation/schema examples; not a complete source audit.
findings: Preprocessing, graph-pair preparation, alignment solving and scoring are separate configurable components.
Inspected API defaults to no-op graph standardization and hill climbing; CLI parser defaults to ILP and pairwise scoring unless configured otherwise.
ILP has a time limit and returns objective value and bound; optimality requires inspecting the gap/status, not only selecting a solver name.

Generic standardization lowercases, removes quotes, relabels variables and deinverts relations. Selecting AMR standardization additionally handles domain/mod, root concepts, dereification and duplicate removal.
Default IDTripleMatcher is exact; alternative weighted/embedding matchers have different semantics. TripleScorer uses count-aware matching, and ResultPrinter distinguishes micro/macro summaries.
LICENSE contains GNU General Public License Version 3. No source was copied or relicensing interpretation made.
adopt: Explicit separation of normalization, alignment and scoring, with solver-bound inspection.
adapt: Possible bounded structural diagnostics after a project-specific meaning-preserving projection.
reject: Unconfigured AMR standardization or embedding triple similarity as scientific truth.
Assuming CLI and API names imply identical defaults.
